Subject: Q3 inference deployment — next steps & action items

Hi Chris — great running through StellarApps' use case earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned as you head into your EOQ planning:

Recap:
- Primary workload: customer-facing summarization pipeline (~60k monthly active users, 1.2M requests/month)
- Target latency: p95 < 250ms for short-form summaries
- Key constraints: SOC 2 compliance, VPC-required for prod, tight cost targets for Q3 rollout

Proposed mutual action plan:
1) Redwood to deliver: draft SOW + preliminary pricing grid (attached) by EOD Tue (see Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf, pricing_grid.xlsx)
2) StellarApps to confirm: priority for Q3 launch, internal approvers (security/procurement/contact), and any must-have gating items by end of week
3) Schedule: optional technical deep-dive with infra on Thurs if you want a performance runbook

Two specific asks for planning: can you confirm whether the budget/approval for a Q3 pilot is still on track for EOQ decisioning? If priorities shifted (e.g., delayed procurement window), let me know — we can adjust the timeline and pricing options accordingly.

If helpful I can also prepare a short one-pager that maps expected unit cost to throughput scenarios for your finance team.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hey Aditya — thanks for the recap and for sending the SOW draft. Appreciate the clear action items. A few quick notes from our side:

- We like the suggested approach and the latency targets look reasonable.
- Procurement and security need to sign off (SOC 2 evidence request is already in motion).
- Budget-wise, we have a Q3 contingency but final approval sits with Finance and is dependent on a couple of other vendor decisions the execs are reviewing this week.

Can you give me a 1-2 pager showing cost vs throughput for the pilot (monthly expected spend for 100k/500k/1M tokens)? I'll share that with Finance. Also please keep the SOW flexible — procurement may request minor redlines.

I'll loop back once I have confirmation from Finance, but not sure that will land before Friday given other EOQ items.

—Chris
